title: Make dashboard self-contained and lifecycle-safe
description: Remove the dashboard CDN requirement, split static assets, use instance-owned command logging, enforce a strict CSP, and implement deterministic readiness and shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard works without internet access; packaged assets and licenses are verified; multiple dashboards do not share command history; start/stop is testable and clean.
close_reason: Extracted the dashboard into dashboard.py; packaged project-owned CSS and JavaScript with no CDN or internet dependency; enforced a strict same-origin CSP; replaced browser Socket.IO with automatic same-origin polling; made telemetry instance-owned; added synchronous readiness, idempotent shutdown, thread joining, and observer detachment; added explicit runtime shutdown; verified isolated histories, real HTTP readiness/stop, wheel asset inclusion, 375 behavioral tests, and 83.91% branch coverage.

title: Extract runtime manager, raw server, interactive shell, and CLI
description: Separate raw server lifecycle, manager state, interactive command dispatch, argument parsing, signals, and process startup from emulator.py.
acceptance_criteria: Signal handlers are installed only by the executable path; bench and compatibility runtimes share explicit lifecycle contracts; CLI behavior and transport tests pass.
close_reason: Extracted executable parsing and signal lifecycle into cli.py, raw TCP session lifecycle into raw_server.py, compatibility runtime management into runtime.py, and interactive command/scenario control into interactive.py. Bench composition and CLI now import focused modules directly while emulator.py preserves exact compatibility re-exports. Verified 375 tests, 83.83% branch coverage, lint, commercial-license gate, sanitization, and both VNA manifest profiles.

title: Extract instrument core and compatibility configuration
description: Move SCPIInstrument and CSV/XLSX compatibility loading out of emulator.py into focused modules while preserving public compatibility imports.
acceptance_criteria: Drivers no longer import the composition-root implementation; old emulator imports remain supported; CSV/bench/catalog behavior and full suite remain unchanged.
close_reason: Extracted the transport-neutral SCPIInstrument into instrument.py and CSV/XLSX validation/loading into configuration.py; changed built-in and CSV drivers to import focused modules directly; retained exact emulator.py compatibility re-exports; documented the boundary and added direct-module/facade regression coverage. Full suite, 82% coverage gate, lint, commercial-license gate, and both 393/393 VNA manifests pass.

title: Correct repository documentation and tracker truth
description: Correct stale TODO, roadmap, changelog, foundation verification counts, broken links, and recent unreleased feature documentation without changing runtime behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Documentation describes version 4.x and Python 3.10+; TODO matches Beads; local links pass; current verification numbers and changelog are accurate.
close_reason: Replaced stale milestone checklists and version-2 roadmap claims with a Beads-backed version-4 roadmap; added an Unreleased changelog section for live scenario work; corrected the foundation status, unfinished scope, wording, verification snapshot, and broken VNA link; added regression tests for local documentation links and current release/support claims.

title: Repository cleanup and modularization
description: Reduce architectural coupling and repository drift without changing instrument behavior. Work is split into small verified issues covering documentation truth, module extraction, dashboard lifecycle/offline operation, CSV parser correctness, CI consolidation, example organization, generated catalog data, formatting, and eventual compatibility-facade removal.
acceptance_criteria: All child issues are complete; supported CLI/import contracts remain explicit; full tests, coverage, license, manifest, package, and container gates pass.

title: Add live scenario loading to dashboard and interactive manager
description: Make deterministic scenario playback directly usable without custom Python or API scripting by adding dashboard JSON loading and interactive scenario commands for configured instruments.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard can select an instrument and upload/paste schema-1 scenario JSON while servers remain running; interactive mode implements scenario load/status/start/pause/reset/step; stream controls clearly describe their purpose; errors are plain and non-destructive; tests and docs cover the real workflow.
close_reason: Implemented live schema-1 scenario loading in each dashboard instrument card with optional immediate start, clarified the noise-stream selector, and added interactive scenario load/status/start/pause/reset/step commands that work while servers run and respect the instrument session lock. Added focused, full-suite, coverage, license, and documentation verification.

title: Verify and release generic instrument profiles
description: Complete the 4.0.0 breaking release verification and installed-package smoke tests.
acceptance_criteria: Full tests, Ruff, coverage gate, license policy, manifests, build, isolated wheel, CLI/bench smoke, repository sanitation, and GitHub CI pass.
close_reason: Release verification passed: 357 functional tests plus sanitation suite staging, 83.82% coverage, Ruff, 32-package royalty-free commercial/enterprise license gate, both VNA manifests at 393/393, source/wheel build, isolated 4.0.0 CLI install, and all bench example smoke tests.

title: Generalize power supply state to one through four outputs
description: Replace the fixed triple-output implementation with an output-count-driven system shared by four generic PSU profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Each profile exposes exactly its configured outputs with independent state, invalid selection errors, *CLS preservation, *RST reset, and multi-instance isolation.
close_reason: The stateful PSU system now supports exactly one through four independent outputs, validates selection bounds, preserves state on CLS, resets on RST, and remains isolated per instrument instance.

title: Migrate built-in drivers to generic selectors
description: Rename the built-in DMM and VNA profiles and generalize the power-supply driver to project-owned generic selectors.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog exposes virtual-dmm/dmm, virtual-vna/vna-2-port and vna-4-port, and virtual-ps/ps-1-output through ps-4-output with no legacy aliases.
close_reason: Catalog now exposes only project-owned virtual-dmm/dmm, virtual-vna/vna-2-port and vna-4-port, and virtual-ps/ps-1-output through ps-4-output selectors, with no compatibility aliases.

title: Add bench schema v2 and reported model identity
description: Separate the generic behavior selector from the model text returned by *IDN? using a validated optional reported_model field.
acceptance_criteria: Schema v2 is required; model remains a catalog selector; reported_model overrides only the second four-field identity value across built-in and CSV instruments; malformed identity text fails clearly.
close_reason: Bench schema v2 now requires generic catalog selectors and validates optional reported_model; the override changes only the second IDN field for built-in and CSV instruments.

title: M10: Replace repository-owned instrument models with generic profiles
description: Remove manufacturer-style and model-derived identifiers from all repository-owned instruments while preserving behavior through generic catalog profiles and optional user-supplied reported identity.
acceptance_criteria: Bench schema v2 uses generic profile selectors and optional reported_model; DMM, 1-4 output PSU, VNA, and bundled CSV profiles contain only project-owned generic names; no legacy aliases; release and full-tree audits pass.
close_reason: Version 4.0.0 replaces repository-owned manufacturer-shaped identities with generic DMM, one-to-four-output PSU, VNA, oscilloscope, and signal-generator profiles; schema v2 separates behavior selectors from optional reported_model identity and the complete release gate passed.

title: Verify generic VNA migration and installed CLI
description: Add contract, migration, builder, command-gating, audit, and isolated installation tests for the generic VNA redesign.
acceptance_criteria: Full quality, coverage, licensing, manifest, diff, and installed CLI checks pass.
close_reason: Verified the breaking 3.0.0 release: 360 tests passed, 1 skipped, 2 expected failures; 83.82% coverage passed the 82% gate; Ruff passed; 32 dependency licenses passed the royalty-free commercial/enterprise policy; the built wheel installed cleanly and exposed --version, --help, --bench, and generic VNA bench loading.

title: Rename VNA internals and tracked artifacts
description: Use generic VNA terminology throughout source, profiles, tools, reports, CSV fixtures, tests, documentation, and tracker exports without retaining aliases.
acceptance_criteria: Tracked-tree audit finds no prohibited legacy model, family, or coded-option identifiers; manifests and coverage reports use generic models.
close_reason: Completed the internal and artifact cleanup: VNA-named classes, modules, profiles, tests, tools, reports, CSVs, and documentation were migrated to generic VNA names, with repository sanitization coverage preventing legacy proprietary model/family/coded-option vocabulary.

title: Implement generic VNA catalog and capability contract
description: Replace model-derived hardware and coded application configuration with fixed port-count models, semantic source/hardware/application fields, configurable frequency limits, and semantic SCPI reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Both generic models compose and report correct identity, topology, frequency, options, licenses, and application gates.
close_reason: Implemented the generic VNA capability contract with VNA-2PORT-EMU and VNA-4PORT-EMU, configurable frequency range and source count, semantic hardware features and applications, generic identity, semantic option reporting, and documented catalog schema.

title: M9: Replace vendor-derived VNA identity and capability selectors
description: Adopt two project-owned port-count VNA models, semantic hardware/application configuration, generic identity and option reporting, and a clean tracked-tree vocabulary while preserving implemented command behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog and bench composition use only VNA-2PORT-EMU and VNA-4PORT-EMU; no legacy aliases; semantic capability configuration and reporting; full tests, coverage, license gate, package-install smoke test, and tracked-tree identifier audit pass.
close_reason: Delivered the generic VNA product conversion end to end: generic two-port/four-port models, semantic capabilities, configurable frequency/source topology, full internal and documentation cleanup, release artifacts, and passing source plus installed-wheel verification.

title: Keep interactive and startup output Windows-console safe
description: Replace non-ASCII emoji status markers in interactive and long-running CLI output. On Windows cp1252 or redirected output, printing those markers raises UnicodeEncodeError after servers/dashboard start and terminates the process.
acceptance_criteria: CLI and interactive status/error/shutdown messages are plain console-safe text; redirected Windows startup remains alive; tests force an ASCII-only output stream and confirm no UnicodeEncodeError; documentation examples remain readable.
close_reason: Replaced non-ASCII emoji status markers in interactive and long-running CLI output with plain console-safe text. Added a strict ASCII stream regression proving bench startup/resource output no longer raises UnicodeEncodeError under redirected Windows code pages. Combined and full suites pass (356 passed, 1 skipped, 2 expected failures; 84.03% coverage).

title: Push live instrument snapshots to the dashboard
description: Make the dashboard genuinely live. Replace the five-second-only card/counter refresh behavior with event-driven state updates after socket commands, dashboard commands, server lifecycle changes, and scenario mutations while retaining a slow reconnect/fallback poll.
acceptance_criteria: Instrument cards, counters, status registers, errors, acquisition/scenario position, server/client state, and recent command views update immediately without manual refresh; Socket.IO reconnect obtains a full authoritative snapshot; fallback polling remains bounded; rapid commands are coalesced so clients are not flooded; open controls are not unnecessarily destroyed; socket/API/security tests and dashboard docs confirm behavior.
close_reason: Implemented instrument-layer command observers so raw socket, VXI-11, HiSLIP, and dashboard-console commands all emit one command_update plus state_changed event. Added immediate state signals for scenario mutations, raw server/client lifecycle, acquisition trigger, and asynchronous acquisition completion. Browser refreshes are coalesced at 75 ms, preserve open details and unsent control values, refresh fully on reconnect, and retain a 30-second recovery poll. Dashboard docs and WebSocket/API/transport tests updated. Verified by 356 passed, 1 skipped, 2 expected failures, 84.03% coverage, Ruff, and license policy. Direct in-app browser automation was attempted but its installed runtime failed during initialization before opening a tab; integration coverage therefore uses Flask-SocketIO test clients and all transport suites.

title: Load and inspect precise benches in interactive mode
description: Give the interactive session one active runtime abstraction for CSV and catalog-composed benches. Add commands to load a bench JSON, list all configured instruments even when stopped, show resource strings and source bench, start/stop the correct transports, and start the dashboard against the active runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive help documents bench load and instruments commands; paths with spaces work; loading validates transactionally and preserves the current session on failure; instruments lists ID, model/name, transport resource, serial, and running state; start/stop/web operate on the loaded BenchRuntime; existing CSV load and no-flag behavior remain compatible; transcript-level tests and docs pass.
close_reason: Implemented one active interactive runtime for CSV and composed benches. Added load bench <file> plus bench <file> alias, instruments listing for stopped/running configurations, model/serial/VISA resource display, transactional failed-load rollback, quoted paths with spaces, and start/stop/status/web routing through the selected BenchRuntime. --bench --interactive now adopts the CLI composition. README and virtual bench docs updated. Verified by 353 passed, 1 skipped, 2 expected failures, 83.99% coverage, Ruff, and diff check.

title: M8: Make bench setup interactive and dashboard state genuinely live
description: Expose catalog discovery, bench loading, instrument inspection, and guided bench creation through the no-flag interactive experience, and replace dashboard polling-only state with immediate event-driven updates.
acceptance_criteria: A non-scripting user can browse available models, load and inspect a saved bench, create and save a validated bench from catalog choices, start it, see VISA resources, and observe command/state changes immediately in the dashboard without manual refresh or a five-second wait.
close_reason: Completed the interactive bench setup and live-dashboard milestone. Interactive mode can load and inspect precise benches, browse built-in and CSV catalogs, create validated mixed benches through a guided workflow, and operate an event-driven live dashboard across supported transports. Windows console output is ASCII-safe. All child issues are closed; full verification passed with 364 tests passed, 1 skipped, 2 expected failures, 83.94% coverage, and the commercial dependency-license policy passing.

title: Adapt VNA traces and application results to scenario streams
description: Allow base VNA and application measurements, including gain compression and other trace-like results, to source deterministic complex traces, scalar summaries, and related metadata from scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: A scenario can provide channel/measurement-specific frequency axes and complex or formatted trace data; application results remain coherent with trace and marker queries; ASCII and binary formats return the same underlying sample; trigger/OPC advances data deterministically.
notes: Supersession review: scpi-303 has been redesigned to integrate VNA traces with scpi-703 from the start. Do not implement this as a retrofit. Keep it open until scpi-303 is implemented and confirms that base and application trace outputs use the shared engine; then close scpi-705 as superseded if no distinct work remains.
close_reason: Superseded by the direct shared-engine design completed in scpi-303 and extended to application arrays/scalars in scpi-403. VNA trace and active-device results already use ScenarioPlayer read/trigger/operation policies, ASCII/binary encoding, shape errors, and reset semantics; no retrofit remains.

title: Build the deterministic scenario and queued-data engine
description: Create an instrument-neutral engine for scripted DUT scenarios and sequential measurement data, supporting scalar values, traces, tables, events, and errors.
acceptance_criteria: Scenarios define named streams with ordered samples; consumption policy supports advance-on-read, advance-on-trigger/operation, hold-last, loop, and explicit exhaustion error; reset, seed, timing, and playback position are deterministic and observable; data may be loaded from documented human-readable and binary formats.
notes: Backlog sequencing decision 2026-08-21: work immediately after scpi-701 and before any further M3 implementation. VNA data generation must consume this shared engine rather than create a bespoke one.
close_reason: Implemented and verified the generic deterministic scenario/data engine, playback policies, timing, resettable seeds, JSON/binary codecs, and observable thread-safe positions.

title: Implement reusable virtual bench composition
description: Allow users to select catalog instruments, assign resource addresses and configurations, validate conflicts, and save/load a complete bench definition.
acceptance_criteria: A versioned bench file can create multiple named instruments with model, options, address, and driver configuration; invalid addresses or configurations fail transactionally; the same file starts an equivalent bench locally or on a remote host.
close_reason: Implemented and verified versioned bench JSON, catalog-backed transactional composition, resource validation/rendering, host overrides, and rollback-safe multi-instrument socket startup.

title: Define the emulator driver and instrument catalog contract
description: Define the plug-in contract and metadata by which an instrument family advertises supported models, firmware snapshots, options, transports, commands, scenario input types, and maturity/coverage.
acceptance_criteria: The catalog can enumerate available drivers/emulators without importing UI code; each entry identifies model/firmware/options, supported resources, coverage, and scenario capabilities; adding a driver does not require modifying the bench composer core.
notes: Backlog sequencing decision 2026-08-21: work this next, before any further M3 implementation. It establishes the contract needed by scpi-703.
close_reason: Implemented and verified UI-independent driver/catalog contract, built-in VNA metadata/factory, and third-party entry-point discovery.

title: M7: Compose virtual benches and run deterministic DUT scenarios
description: Let users select supported instrument emulators, assemble and save a virtual ATE bench, and drive those instruments with deterministic scenario data before physical equipment is available. This project emulates instruments and their observable measurements; digital DUT/firmware emulation remains a separate companion project.
acceptance_criteria: A user can discover available emulator profiles, compose a multi-instrument bench, load a reusable DUT scenario, run automation locally or remotely, and obtain reproducible scalar and trace responses through normal instrument interfaces.
close_reason: All M7 children are complete: catalog discovery, reusable bench composition, deterministic shared scenario engine, DMM and VNA adapters, and authenticated local/remote scenario orchestration. Scalar/trace workflows, reproducible playback, normal SCPI interfaces, and a live remote example are verified.

title: Fix active *CLS state corruption and response regression
description: The active SCPIInstrument *CLS handler clears the entire instrument state dictionary. It must clear only error/event status and must leave measurement/configuration values, command handlers, ESE/SRE masks, and the client connection usable.
acceptance_criteria: Direct and raw-socket tests set state, issue *CLS, then verify errors/events clear while values and enable masks persist and subsequent queries respond without restarting the server.
close_reason: Fixed active SCPIInstrument *CLS so it clears queued errors and ESR/STB latches without clearing instrument values or ESE/SRE masks. Added direct and raw-TCP regressions proving the same connection remains responsive after *CLS.

title: Separate and secure the web control plane
description: Remove direct unsynchronized mutation, bind locally by default, validate inputs, prevent XSS/CSRF, and authenticate remote access.
acceptance_criteria: Security tests cover mutating routes and no untrusted content is injected as HTML.
notes: Keep near the top of the queue alongside scpi-701, scpi-703, and scpi-501; security hardening must not slip behind new feature epics.
close_reason: Implemented local-only dashboard defaults, required bearer and WebSocket authentication for remote binds, CSRF checks for mutating APIs, same-origin Socket.IO, bounded validated input, serialized server and instrument mutation, browser security headers, and XSS-safe history/live rendering with security regression tests.

title: Implement VXI-11 INSTR transport, device clear, trigger, lock, and SRQ
description: Implement ONC RPC VXI-11 and bridge clear, trigger, abort, locks, status polling, and service requests to the core.
acceptance_criteria: PyVISA INSTR, device clear, serial poll, and OPC-driven SRQ integration tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented bounded ONC RPC/XDR VXI-11 core, async, portmapper, and interrupt programs; exclusive links/locks; byte-safe reads/writes; Device Clear, bus trigger, abort, serial poll/MAV, and OPC-driven SRQ. Verified with PyVISA-Py and native VISA TCPIP INSTR integration tests.

title: Harden raw SCPI socket transport on port 5025
description: Implement bounded framing, configurable termination, binary-safe I/O, sessions, timeouts, shutdown, and backpressure.
acceptance_criteria: PyVISA SOCKET tests pass under fragmentation, chaining, large transfers, timeouts, backpressure, and shutdown. Each instrument permits only one active TCP session at a time; additional connection attempts are rejected or queued and cannot concurrently mutate the same instrument state.
close_reason: Implemented bounded binary-aware raw socket framing, configurable termination, standard port 5025 defaults, single active instrument sessions, idle/send timeouts, output-queue backpressure, clean shutdown, and protocol-level regression coverage for fragmentation, chaining, binary transfers, concurrency, timeouts, and shutdown.

title: Implement calibration, ECal, cal kits, cal sets, and correction
description: Model guided and unguided acquisition, standards, kits, ECal, cal-set persistence, correction, and invalidation.
acceptance_criteria: Representative SOLT, TRL, and ECal workflows complete with OPC/status behavior and alter corrected data.
close_reason: Out of scope by product decision: do not model VNA calibration, ECal, correction behavior, or calibration mathematics. Calibration/correction status will be a static always-0 response unrelated to modeled state.

title: Implement deterministic S-parameter and receiver data generation
description: Implement deterministic S-parameter and receiver-data generation as a VNA adapter over the generic scenario and queued-data engine delivered by scpi-703. VNA SDATA, FDATA, RDATA, and SNP responses must consume named scenario streams and the shared playback/advancement model from the start; do not build a standalone VNA-specific data engine that would require later retrofit. Procedural DUT models, seeded noise, and imperfections may generate samples, but they must publish through the same generic engine used by other instrument shapes.
acceptance_criteria: scpi-703 is complete first. VNA ASCII and binary arrays have correct lengths, ordering, and channel transforms while consuming the same scenario streams, advancement policies, reset behavior, timing, and deterministic seeds as non-VNA instruments. Tests prove trace selection and triggered acquisition use the shared engine, and no parallel VNA-only scenario or playback implementation exists.
notes: Design confirmed 2026-08-21: this issue owns the original VNA integration with scpi-703, not a later adapter.
close_reason: Implemented VNA SDATA, FDATA, RDATA, physical receiver, SNP, and X-axis adapters directly over the shared ScenarioPlayer; ASCII/binary formats, binding, point validation, read/trigger/operation policies, errors, seeds/reset behavior; 161/161 coverage and 243 tests pass.

title: Implement stimulus, source, receiver, segment, and sweep behavior
description: Model linear, log, CW, power, and segment sweeps, IF bandwidth, points, source power, receiver settings, and timing.
acceptance_criteria: Axes, timing, trigger completion, limits, and X-values are coherent across channels.
close_reason: Implemented coherent linear, logarithmic, CW, power, and segment sweep state; frequency/source/receiver/IFBW/dwell controls; model limits; measurement X-axis propagation; acquisition/OPC-derived timing; expanded manifest reports to 154/154; 235 tests pass.

title: Implement VNA channels, measurements, traces, windows, and markers
description: Model channel and measurement lifecycles, selected context, display feeds, formats, markers, math, memory, limits, and equations.
acceptance_criteria: Indexed and abbreviated CALC and DISP workflows match VNA state and catalogs.
close_reason: Implemented stateful indexed/abbreviated VNA channel, measurement, display window/trace, format, math-memory, marker, limit, and equation workflows; documented reset semantics; expanded verified manifest coverage to 108/108; 227 tests pass.

title: Implement VNA hardware, option, license, and capability queries
description: Model ports, sources, receivers, attenuators, paths, IF hardware, limits, hardware options, and application licenses.
acceptance_criteria: IDN, OPT, SYST:CAPability, catalogs, and valid-value queries remain internally consistent.
close_reason: Implemented immutable VNA profiles with consistent IDN, OPT, frequency, hardware, port/source, attenuator, receiver, and license capability queries; expanded manifest to 64 commands at 100% coverage

title: Create authoritative VNA SCPI command manifest pipeline
description: Maintain project-owned command syntax, applicability, types, responses, defaults, and supersession metadata in the internal emulator contract.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage reports compare implementation to the selected internal contract snapshot and flag gaps.
close_reason: Added validated A.20.25 command manifest, implementation-key introspection, model coverage reports, gap-failing CLI, and freshness tests

title: Implement output queue, MAV, and IEEE binary blocks
description: Decouple query execution from reads and support ASCII plus definite and indefinite binary blocks and data byte order.
acceptance_criteria: MAV follows queued output and large arrays survive partial and fragmented transport reads.
close_reason: Implemented active byte output queue with MAV propagation, partial reads, -410 query interruption, -430 query deadlock/capacity handling, ASCII responses, definite/indefinite IEEE blocks, REAL/INTEGER binary encoding, NORM/SWAP byte order, and exact 1 MiB fragmented TCP transfer; 12 output tests plus socket integration pass.

title: Pin VNA models and firmware documentation snapshots
description: Define the initial generic two-port and four-port VNA firmware profiles and versioned capability policy.
acceptance_criteria: A project-owned profile identifies models, firmware, ports, sources, semantic hardware features, applications, and snapshot date.
close_reason: Pinned the initial generic two-port and four-port VNA capability profile with project-owned metadata, applications, policy, and tests.

title: Implement channel-aware trigger and acquisition state machines
description: Support idle, armed, waiting, sweeping, processing, complete, and aborted states with internal, manual, external, and bus triggers.
acceptance_criteria: INIT, TRIG, sweep modes, averaging, delays, and ABOR produce tested transitions and status events.
close_reason: Implemented active channel-aware acquisition states (idle, armed, waiting, sweeping, processing, complete, aborted), internal/manual/external/bus triggers, trigger delays, single/group/continuous/hold sweep modes, averaging, ABOR propagation, Operation Status conditions, and real INIT-to-OPC TCP handshaking; 10 acquisition tests plus socket integration pass.

title: Implement asynchronous operations and OPC/WAI semantics
description: Represent overlapped operations and completion fences for OPC, WAI, abort, sweep, calibration, and file operations.
acceptance_criteria: OPC sets ESR only after prior work; OPC? delays response; WAI gates commands; cancellation is deterministic.
close_reason: Implemented and wired overlapped operation fences: *OPC latches SESR bit 0 only after prior work; ESE bit 0 drives ESB and SRE bit 5 drives MSS/RQS; *OPC? blocks and returns 1 without setting ESR; *WAI gates later program units; ABOR and failures resolve deterministically. Direct and raw-TCP tests pass.

title: Implement ESR, ESE, STB, SRE, operation and questionable status
description: Implement condition, event, enable, and transition registers plus computed MAV, ESB, MSS/RQS, operation, questionable, and error summaries.
acceptance_criteria: Destructive and nondestructive reads and all summary propagation are tested bit for bit.
close_reason: Implemented IEEE 488.2 ESR/ESE/STB/SRE and SCPI operation/questionable condition, event, enable, positive/negative transition registers with error, MAV, ESB, MSS/RQS, operation, and questionable summary propagation; 15 status tests pass.

title: Implement bounded error queues and standard error mapping
description: Provide FIFO errors, queue overflow, SYST:ERR?, SYST:ERR:COUN?, and command, execution, device, and query classifications.
acceptance_criteria: Errors are ordered and bounded, clear correctly, and set corresponding Standard Event Status bits.
close_reason: Implemented thread-safe bounded FIFO errors, -350 overflow behavior, standard SCPI error records/messages, SYST:ERR?/COUN? payloads, and command/execution/device/query SESR bit latching; 17 error/status tests pass.

title: Implement typed command registry and capability guards
description: Replace executable configuration regexes with typed command specifications, coercion, validation, defaults, and availability predicates.
acceptance_criteria: Handlers receive typed values and invalid or unavailable commands produce deterministic SCPI errors.
close_reason: Implemented typed CommandSpec/ParameterSpec registry with SCPI abbreviation matching, indexed header bindings, typed coercion, range/unit/enum validation, capability predicates, and deterministic command errors; 13 registry tests pass.

title: Implement SCPI tokenizer and program-message parser
description: Support abbreviated hierarchical headers, relative paths, chaining, strings, numeric forms, units, lists, and indexed nodes.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover valid and invalid programs without changing string case or splitting inside strings and binary data.
close_reason: Implemented byte-safe SCPI program-message parsing with relative/absolute headers, indexed nodes, abbreviation matching, strings, numeric units, lists, and IEEE binary blocks; 26 parser tests pass.

title: Repair and validate instrument configuration data
description: Fix malformed CSV quoting, remove Markdown contamination, detect duplicate ports, IDs, and commands, and define a validated schema.
acceptance_criteria: All profiles parse without column loss; malformed rows fail clearly; no phantom instruments exist.
notes: Added strict five-column CSV/XLSX header validation, field-overflow diagnostics, duplicate equipment/port/command detection, port and validation-rule checks, atomic reload behavior, and support for write-only commands. Normalized detailed_instruments.csv to 8 valid instruments/261 rows and vna-commands.csv to one correctly labeled generic two-port VNA/287 rows with intact comma-containing responses. Final validation: 25 passed, 3 strict xfails, Ruff clean.
close_reason: Closed

title: Characterize current behavior with regression tests
description: Capture current parsing, validation, state, TCP framing, and configuration behavior before replacement.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests document supported and known-incorrect behavior without manual telnet testing.
notes: Added 13 behavior tests covering instrument identity/state, range and enum validation, FIFO error draining, undefined headers, chaining, reset defaults, CSV loading/schema rejection, and terminated/fragmented/timeout raw socket framing. Suite result: 14 passed and 3 strict xfails documenting unsupported IEEE enable setters, string case loss, and quoted-semicolon parsing.
close_reason: Closed

title: Create canonical src package and CLI entry point
description: Create src/scpi_emulator modules, pyproject metadata, supported Python policy, dependency groups, and one CLI.
acceptance_criteria: The package installs cleanly; one documented CLI launches it; duplicate version scripts are retired or archived.
notes: Implemented canonical src/scpi_emulator package, pyproject dependency groups, console and module entry points, packaged dashboard template, archived older scripts, and updated installation docs. Validated editable install on Python 3.14.7, 4 pytest tests, compileall, Ruff, and both --version entry points.
close_reason: Closed

title: M5: Deliver VISA/LXI-compatible transports
description: Provide robust raw SCPI plus true INSTR transports and service-request delivery.
acceptance_criteria: PyVISA integration tests pass for SOCKET and at least VXI-11 INSTR resources.
close_reason: Completed raw socket hardening, VXI-11 INSTR core/async/interrupt interoperability, and HiSLIP 1.0 plus optional LXI discovery. Real PyVISA-Py and native VISA clients exercise query, Device Clear, trigger/status, locking, and OPC/SRQ paths.

title: M2: Build versioned VNA and four-port VNA capability system
description: Model generic virtual VNA hardware shapes, firmware tokens, semantic hardware features, application capabilities, and command applicability.
acceptance_criteria: Two-port and four-port generic profiles report coherent identities and capabilities and correctly gate commands.
close_reason: Closed

title: M1: Implement SCPI and IEEE 488.2 core
description: Build the standards-oriented parser, typed command registry, queues, status registers, operations, and trigger engine used by all profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Core conformance tests cover parsing, errors, status propagation, synchronization, triggers, and binary data.
close_reason: Completed all eight M1 parser, registry, error, status, synchronization, trigger/acquisition, regression, and binary output deliverables with active-runtime and raw-TCP conformance coverage.

title: M0: Establish a maintainable emulator foundation
description: Replace the three-script prototype with a canonical, packaged, testable project while preserving useful behavior and data.
acceptance_criteria: One supported entry point exists; tests run in CI; malformed configuration is rejected; documentation matches implemented behavior.
close_reason: All children completed

title: Organize examples and remove unsupported historical scripts
description: Move supported CSV fixtures into a clear examples location, update Docker/tests/docs atomically, and remove unsupported standalone and legacy scripts already preserved in Git history.
acceptance_criteria: All supported examples remain copyable and tested; Docker starts; no supported entry point references removed files; repository root is reduced.

title: Consolidate CI and verification entry points
description: Merge overlapping GitHub Actions workflows and make local/release verification consistent while retaining supported Python, Windows/Linux, license, coverage, manifest, wheel, and container gates.
acceptance_criteria: One workflow provides the existing guarantees without duplicate suite execution; documented local verification matches hosted CI.
close_reason: Replaced two overlapping GitHub Actions workflows and the CI-only pytest wrapper with one ci.yml and tools/verify.py. Unique Linux/Windows Python 3.10-3.14 configurations call the shared test profile once; Linux 3.14 owns the quality profile for lint, reviewed commercial licenses, branch coverage, both manifests, isolated sdist/wheel build, package-content checks, and installed-wheel CLI/bench smoke tests; the container socket gate remains separate. Release and README commands now call the same profiles. Consolidated quality passed end-to-end, and the exposed HiSLIP serial-poll race was made deterministic and stress-tested.

title: Repair CSV case and quoted-semicolon dispatch
description: Route CSV compatibility commands through parser-safe message boundaries while retaining original parameter text and the existing five-column schema.
acceptance_criteria: Mixed-case parameters and semicolons inside quoted values are preserved; both strict expected failures become passing tests; existing CSV profiles remain compatible.
close_reason: Reused the typed parser's quote- and binary-aware program-unit splitter for compatibility dispatch; matched CSV command syntax case-insensitively against original text so free-form parameter case is preserved; retained canonical uppercase enum/bool state; removed both strict xfails and added chained quoted-semicolon coverage. Existing CSV loading, catalog, socket, binary, parser, and instrument regressions pass with no schema change.

title: Sanitize bundled CSVs documentation and tracked artifacts
description: Rename every repository-owned CSV equipment block, example, manifest, report, test, document, and tracker export to generic instrument terminology.
acceptance_criteria: Bundled DMM, PSU, oscilloscope, generator, and VNA assets use only approved generic labels; oscilloscope Type A/B remain static experimental CSV profiles; whole-tree content and filename audits pass.
close_reason: Bundled CSVs, examples, profiles, reports, docs, legacy snapshots, tests, and UI labels now use generic project-owned identities; oscilloscope Type A/B remain static experimental CSV profiles.

title: Create and save benches through a guided catalog workflow
description: Add a simple interactive bench builder that asks for driver/model, instance ID, name, serial, implemented transport, host/port, and supported driver configuration, permits multiple instruments, validates through BenchComposer, previews resources, and saves schema-version-1 JSON.
acceptance_criteria: A user can create a mixed multi-instrument bench without writing JSON; defaults require minimal knowledge; duplicate IDs/resources and invalid configuration are caught before save; cancel never leaves a partial file; saved output round-trips through --bench and can be loaded immediately; tests and a beginner walkthrough cover the complete flow.
close_reason: Implemented guided interactive bench creation with driver/model/transport discovery, safe defaults, unique resources and serials, optional driver-owned advanced fields, one-step all-applications selection, CSV discovery, validation, cancellation without partial output, atomic JSON save, preview, and immediate runtime adoption. Added builder and CLI tests plus README/virtual-benches documentation. Coverage confirmed by the full suite: 364 passed, 1 skipped, 2 xfailed; total coverage 83.94% (82% gate); commercial license gate and diff checks pass.

title: Browse driver catalog from interactive mode
description: Add interactive catalog commands that list drivers/models and inspect one model's maturity, firmware, transports, configuration shape, hardware/application token counts, scenario inputs, and command coverage using DriverDescriptor data rather than duplicated UI constants.
acceptance_criteria: catalog, catalog <driver>, and catalog <driver> <model> produce readable deterministic output; CSV models can be included by selecting a CSV directory; invalid selections fail plainly without leaving the shell; output and help have transcript tests and documentation.
close_reason: Added driver-owned configuration field descriptors and interactive catalog commands: catalog, catalog <driver>, catalog <driver> <model>, and catalog csv <folder>. Views expose maturity, models, firmware, implemented/planned transports, configuration shapes/defaults/choice counts, hardware/application counts, scenario inputs, and command coverage without UI-specific constants. Quoted CSV directory paths and plain errors are covered. README/catalog docs updated. Verified by 358 passed, 1 skipped, 2 expected failures, 84.09% coverage, and Ruff.

title: Allow bench VNA frequency capability overrides
description: Allow virtual-vna bench configuration to optionally override frequency_minimum_hz and frequency_maximum_hz while inheriting omitted endpoints from the selected model profile.
acceptance_criteria: Omitted endpoints retain model defaults; valid narrowing overrides drive SYST:CAP frequency queries, sweep/trace initialization, and existing application range validation; values outside the model envelope or inverted/invalid ranges fail bench composition clearly; tests and catalog documentation cover defaults, partial overrides, complete overrides, and failures.
close_reason: Implemented optional frequency_minimum_hz and frequency_maximum_hz virtual-vna bench configuration. Omitted endpoints inherit the selected model's 10 MHz/26.5 GHz defaults; overrides may narrow but not extend the model envelope. Capability queries, initial sweep/trace axes, sweep and application range validators all consume the resolved range. Invalid, nonnumeric, out-of-envelope, or inverted ranges fail composition before sockets start. Catalog and bench docs updated. Verified by 350 passed, 1 skipped, 2 expected failures, 83.69% coverage, Ruff, diff check, and the royalty-free commercial/enterprise license gate.

title: Publish a complete user-facing instrument catalog
description: Create one clear catalog document listing every built-in and CSV driver, model ID, maturity, firmware, transports, bench fields, accepted configuration keys, defaults, hardware configuration/add-on tokens, application option tokens, serial behavior, and copyable JSON. Link it prominently from README and bench docs. Keep option identifiers opaque and do not copy or explain manufacturer manual content.
acceptance_criteria: A user can build model-faithful, all-applications, DMM, triple-PSU, and CSV bench entries without reading source; all catalog values match runtime descriptors/matrix; README links the catalog near Quick Start; tests detect stale driver/model documentation.
close_reason: Published docs/instrument-catalog.md as the single beginner-facing reference for every runtime driver/model, common bench field, accepted driver configuration, default, mode, hardware configuration/add-on token, transport, serial rule, CSV naming rule, and copyable JSON. Published concrete application identifiers only in docs/instrument-options.json as an opaque structured list, preserving the no-option-explanations/no-concrete-IDs-in-Markdown policy. Linked from README Quick Start and virtual bench docs. Tests compare the documents to live descriptors and the compatibility matrix and parse every JSON example. Full suite: 341 passed, 1 skipped, 2 expected xfails; lint passed.

title: Implement stateful triple-output PSU driver
description: Replace the model-faithfulness gap in the legacy Virtual PS 3 Output CSV profile with a catalog-visible built-in triple-output PSU driver using independent output state and generic SCPI selected-channel behavior. Do not copy manufacturer manual text.
acceptance_criteria: Three independently selectable outputs retain voltage/current/output/protection state; measurement queries follow selected output; *RST resets all outputs; *CLS preserves configured output state; bench can compose two PSU instances with unique serials and ports; docs show mixed built-in/CSV usage; tests cover behavior.
close_reason: Added catalog-visible virtual-triple-psu / Virtual PS 3 Output built-in driver with three independent selected-output states, voltage/current/output/protection/range/measurement commands, *CLS preservation, *RST reset, unique serials, two-instance bench coverage, mixed CSV example, docs, and CI smoke. Legacy single-context CSV PSU was relabeled generically. No manufacturer manual text used.

title: Add per-instance serial numbers to virtual benches
description: Add an optional serial_number field to bench instruments and driver requests. Apply it consistently to built-in and CSV *IDN? identity so multiple instances of one model can be uniquely identified.
acceptance_criteria: Bench JSON round-trips serial_number; DMM, VNA, CSV, and PSU instances return the requested serial in *IDN?; two instances of one CSV model can use different serials; existing bench files remain valid.
close_reason: Added optional bench serial_number through JSON codec, BenchInstrument, InstrumentRequest, composer, and DMM/VNA/CSV/PSU factories. Same-model CSV and built-in instances now return distinct requested serials in *IDN?. Covered round-trip and all driver families.

title: Document --load paths, CSV format, and quoting rules
description: Replace the thin --load documentation with beginner-oriented, copy/pasteable guidance for single files and directories, including shell path quoting, exact CSV columns, equipment blocks, port assignment, CSV field quoting, directory traversal, failure behavior, and interaction with --start/--web/--bench.
acceptance_criteria: README links to a detailed loading guide; Windows PowerShell and POSIX examples clearly state when path quotes are required; CSV examples demonstrate quoted comma-containing responses and continuation rows; directory/file behavior and errors match implementation; no new CLI behavior is claimed.
close_reason: Expanded ZIP installation documentation to require environment activation or explicit venv executable use, show Get-Command stale-executable detection, and clarify that extracting a ZIP does not update an older installed command. Existing CSV load/path/quoting guide remains linked and verified.

title: Add simple directory loading and precise bench CLI modes
description: Extend the existing --load option to accept a directory of legacy CSV instrument definitions, while exposing the existing versioned bench composition path through a mutually exclusive --bench option. Reuse shared loaders and startup/dashboard behavior; print concrete client resources and fail in plain language.
acceptance_criteria: scpi-emulator --load instruments/ --start loads every CSV with globally unique equipment IDs and ports, prints each VISA resource, and rejects duplicate equipment names with both filenames; --bench bench.json composes and starts the precise catalog-backed bench; argparse rejects --bench with --load; dashboard flags and shutdown behavior work in both modes; no flags remain interactive; malformed inputs never expose tracebacks; CLI tests and README/help document both paths in parallel.
close_reason: Verified and promoted through the real release path. Root cause was branch exposure: --bench worked on codex/emulator-foundation, while origin/main lacked the packaged src/scpi_emulator code. Fast-forwarded the full tested foundation to the default main branch. Added examples/virtual-bench.json and CI checks that install the built wheel, assert the generated scpi-emulator help exposes --bench FILE, and run scpi-emulator --bench examples/virtual-bench.json successfully. Clean isolated-wheel smoke on main passed; remote origin/main now contains both the parser option and example. Full regression before promotion: 332 passed, 1 skipped, 2 documented xfails.

title: Expose CSV instruments through catalog and scenario streams
description: Wire legacy five-column CSV instruments into the shipped driver catalog and deterministic scenario engine. Reuse the existing CSV loader and CSVCommandAdapter without changing the CSV schema: catalog configured CSV equipment blocks as experimental raw-socket drivers and recognize {{scenario:<stream_name>}} values in the existing Response column.
acceptance_criteria: Configured CSV Equipment blocks are selectable through DriverCatalog and virtual bench composition; CSVCommandAdapter can read attached ScenarioPlayer streams through {{scenario:name}} response markers; instruments without attached scenarios preserve canned-response behavior; parsing is shared with SCPIEmulatorManager.load_from_file; tests and virtual-bench documentation cover the complete path.
close_reason: Completed catalog visibility and deterministic scenario-stream support for legacy CSV instruments. CSV Equipment blocks are exposed as models through the opt-in csv-instruments catalog driver and can be selected in virtual benches; {{scenario:name}} Response values consume the shared ScenarioPlayer while ordinary canned responses remain unchanged. SCPIEmulatorManager and CSVDriver now reuse one parsing/construction path, and no CSV schema change was required. Tests, bench documentation, coverage, license, manifest, lint, and package gates pass.

title: Add scenario control, authoring examples, and remote ATE workflow
description: Expose scenario selection, start, pause, step, reset, inspection, and fault injection through supported configuration/control interfaces, with examples for remote ATE development.
acceptance_criteria: Documented examples launch a bench, select a DUT scenario, run an automation sequence, inspect playback, and reproduce a failure; control-plane actions do not bypass SCPI status/error semantics; workflows work without physical rack space or locally attached equipment.
close_reason: Implemented shared-player pause/resume/manual-step/reset/inspection, authenticated per-instrument scenario selection and lifecycle APIs, SCPI error/status fault injection, BenchRuntime control-plane integration, runnable remote DMM bench/client examples, security and workflow docs, and end-to-end tests. Live smoke returned 3.3/3.1/4.8 and reproduced -222 through STB/SYST:ERR; 280 tests pass at 82.85% branch coverage.

title: Adapt DMM and scalar instruments to scenario streams
description: Provide a reference DMM/scalar adapter so READ, FETCH, and MEASURE responses can consume queued values while respecting triggering, units, range, status, and errors.
acceptance_criteria: A test can model a DUT sequence such as nominal, drift, limit failure, and recovery; repeated reads or triggers return the configured sequence according to policy; exhaustion and reset behavior are tested.
close_reason: Added a catalog-visible virtual Virtual DMM reference DMM and scalar ScenarioPlayer adapter for READ/FETCH/MEASURE, function/range configuration, cached fetch, read/trigger/operation policies, exhaustion/errors, and CLS/RST semantics; 250 tests pass.

title: Add CI, Docker, coverage gates, compatibility reports, and release docs
description: Build cross-platform tests, containers, coverage thresholds, command coverage reports, and verified quick starts.
acceptance_criteria: A clean clone can build, test, run, and execute a documented PyVISA smoke test in CI.
close_reason: Verified live on GitHub Actions at commit 1f21e2d: standalone Python 3.10-3.14 tests pass; Linux/Windows 3.10 and 3.13 matrix passes; coverage, manifests, wheel reinstall, documented CLI, PyVISA-Py VXI-11, and Docker smoke jobs all pass. Added actionable pytest failure annotations and corrected cross-version/status and VISA-backend test portability defects discovered by the live matrix.

title: Implement spectrum, IMD, modulation distortion, phase noise, and DIQ applications
description: Implement remaining advanced measurement classes, setup trees, result data, markers, and capability gating.
acceptance_criteria: Each selected command family has manifest coverage and a deterministic workflow.
close_reason: Implemented licensed spectrum, Swept IMD, modulation distortion, phase noise, Differential I/Q, and wideband-IQ scenario workflows with documented setup trees, CALC:CUST:DEF class creation, deterministic result data, markers, capability/existence gates, reset semantics, tests, docs, and manifest coverage.

title: Implement pulse and Integrated Pulse applications
description: Implement pulse generators, modulation, IF gates and filters, point-in-pulse, pulse profile, and wideband behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Timing constraints, triggers, results, and required-option errors are transcript-tested.
close_reason: Implemented option-021-gated basic and Integrated Pulse applications: five generators, period/delay/width/increment/inversion/trigger controls, standard point-in-pulse and profile modes, time axis, master timing, wideband/software gating, IF filter and path-gate configuration, shared scenario read/trigger policies, static calibration status, transcript errors, docs, and 340/340 manifests. 286 tests pass at 82.81% branch coverage.

title: Implement frequency-offset, mixer, and embedded-LO applications
description: Implement FOM ranges, scalar/vector converters, mixer segments, source roles, and embedded-LO behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Converter workflows produce coherent axes, measurements, the product-decided static always-0 calibration/correction status, and correct errors. No calibration state or mathematics is modeled.
close_reason: Implemented licensed FOM ranges, scalar/vector converter modes, up/down mixer frequency relationships, coherent resampled mixer segments, physical source roles, embedded-LO estimation, composable application processing, and static always-0 calibration/correction status. Correct license, range, source, and existence errors verified; 269 tests pass, branch coverage is 82.86%, and both VNA manifests are 237/237.

title: Implement gain compression and noise figure applications
description: Implement gain compression and noise-figure/power configuration, acquisition, results, and status. Calibration/correction remains the product-decided static always-0 response and is not modeled.
acceptance_criteria: Result arrays and status/errors follow DUT behavior and option constraints.
close_reason: Implemented licensed gain-compression and noise-figure configuration, shared scenario-backed arrays/scalars, trigger policy, address/error enforcement, static calibration status, tests, docs, and manifest coverage.

title: Implement time domain, gating, and fixture simulation applications
description: Implement transforms, gating, embedding, de-embedding, balanced/mixed-mode topology, and fixture simulation.
acceptance_criteria: Settings alter generated results and round-trip through relevant CALC and file commands.
close_reason: Implemented licensed per-channel time transforms, windowing, band-pass/notch gating, deterministic embedding/de-embedding file references, per-port states, balanced/single-ended/mixed topology, and shared SDATA/FDATA/receiver/SNP/X-axis processing; CLS/RST and existence/error semantics verified. 263 tests pass, branch coverage is 82.52%, and both VNA manifests are 191/191.

title: Implement VNA existence registers and named MMEM state files
description: Implement a JSON-file-backed register store per instrument containing only channel -> trace -> measurement-type existence data. Do not store sweep parameters, hardware state, or calibration data. Add a pre-execution existence gate to the command registry: before any channel/trace/measurement-addressed command executes, verify that its address exists in the active composition; otherwise return the correct SCPI error without invoking the handler. Reuse the existing command-gating pattern used by required_capabilities in capabilities.py and registry.py, with an existence predicate instead of a capability predicate. Replace the canned VNA-commands.csv responses for MMEM:STOR:STAT and MMEM:LOAD:STAT with real JSON file writes and reads. Add MMEM:CAT? to list saved JSON files for that instrument and MMEM:DEL to delete one. Non-goals: no calibration state or flag anywhere in this feature, and no replication of the real VNA internal state-file format; provide behavioral parity only by creating live state through normal channel/trace commands, saving it, recalling it, and returning the correct error when an addressed object does not exist. Numbered *SAV/*RCL registers are not part of this VNA feature; they may remain trivially accepted in the shared core for other instrument types without per-slot modeling, because non-VNA profiles are expected to use *RST plus explicit configuration.
acceptance_criteria: The per-instrument JSON store persists and restores only channel, trace, and measurement-type existence. The registry existence gate prevents handlers from running for nonexistent addressed objects and reports the correct SCPI error. MMEM:STOR:STAT and MMEM:LOAD:STAT perform real path-safe named-file operations; MMEM:CAT? lists saved JSON files for that instrument and MMEM:DEL deletes one. Save/recall round trips reproduce existence only and never calibration, sweep, or hardware state. Tests cover live create/save/delete/load, malformed and missing files, nonexistent addresses, and instrument isolation. The existing dependency on scpi-301 remains. After implementation, run tools/pna_manifest.py from the scpi-202 pipeline against the MMEM command group to identify documented MMEM commands that should be added rather than guessing.
close_reason: Implemented path-safe per-instrument JSON MMEM state files that persist existence only, atomic validated recall, catalog/delete, registry existence predicates across VNA measurement/sweep/data addressing, isolation and error tests, and MMEM manifest audit; 256 tests pass and both manifests are 165/165.

title: Add model-faithful and all-applications compatibility modes
description: Support strict physical profiles and a fully licensed developer profile without contradictory hardware responses.
acceptance_criteria: Strict mode rejects unavailable operations; all-apps mode exposes compatible applications coherently.
close_reason: Closed

title: Align README and dependencies with implemented behavior
description: Correct VISA syntax, installation, feature claims, Python support, and optional web dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Documented quick starts run in CI and no unfinished feature is presented as complete.
notes: Replaced the legacy README with accurate alpha capabilities, limitations, installation, raw VISA SOCKET usage, strict configuration documentation, project layout, and Beads workflow. Added GitHub Actions coverage for Python 3.10-3.14, editable install, 25-test regression suite, Ruff, CLI help/version/load, and isolated example generation.
close_reason: Closed

title: M6: Harden dashboard, operations, and release delivery
description: Make the control plane safe, observable, testable, and easy to deploy.
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard is secure by default and releases are reproducible through CI and containers.
close_reason: All M6 hardening and release-delivery work is complete: dashboard security and control-room behavior, release/CI/container workflows, legacy dispatcher cleanup, packaged licensing notices, and dependency-license enforcement are implemented and verified.

title: M3: Implement the base VNA measurement engine
description: Implement channels, measurements, traces, stimulus, sweeps, receivers, data access, calibration, display, and persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Realistic standard S-parameter workflows execute end-to-end and return deterministic data.
notes: Sequencing hold 2026-08-21: do not begin further M3 implementation until scpi-701 and scpi-703 are complete. Beads cannot attach a task dependency directly to this epic, so scpi-301, the M3 entry task, is hard-blocked by scpi-703.
close_reason: All five M3 children are complete: stateful VNA composition, sweep/stimulus behavior, shared-scenario VNA data, existence-only MMEM persistence, and calibration explicitly closed out of scope. End-to-end deterministic S-parameter workflows and 165/165 snapshot coverage are verified.

title: Normalize formatting and strengthen static quality gates
description: Apply formatting and import sorting in isolated mechanical commits, then enforce them without mixing behavior changes into the formatting diff.
acceptance_criteria: Ruff format and import-order checks pass in CI; full behavior suite remains green; no unrelated semantic edits are hidden in formatting commits.

title: Generate catalog option artifacts from runtime descriptors
description: Eliminate manual catalog/profile duplication by generating or exactly validating user-facing option artifacts from driver descriptors.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog JSON and documentation cannot drift from runtime models, firmware, transports, configuration fields, hardware features, and applications.

title: Add virtual front panels, fault injection, and status visualization
description: Expose channels, traces, trigger state, status registers, errors, options, and deterministic fault/noise controls.
acceptance_criteria: Users can observe and control state without bypassing SCPI engine invariants.
close_reason: Completed dashboard control room with non-destructive status, operation, acquisition, capability, channel, measurement, trace, error, and scenario snapshots; session-serialized SCPI/scenario controls; deterministic per-stream noise; SCPI fault injection; documentation and regression coverage.

title: Add HiSLIP and mDNS discovery compatibility
description: Add HiSLIP sessions and LXI discovery after VXI-11 compatibility is stable.
acceptance_criteria: Compatible VISA clients discover and communicate through HiSLIP without changing instrument behavior.
close_reason: Implemented bounded HiSLIP 1.0 paired sync/async sessions with single-client ownership, Data/DataEnd framing, maximum-size negotiation, Device Clear, bus trigger, lock/status operations, and OPC-driven AsyncServiceRequest. Added optional standards-shaped LXI _hislip._tcp/_vxi-11._tcp discovery, bench/catalog integration for VNA and DMM, documentation, PyVISA-Py and native VISA interoperability tests. Verified 302 passed, 1 environment-specific mDNS skip, 2 documented legacy xfails; branch coverage 82.56%.

title: M4: Implement all VNA application command families
description: Add capability-gated behavioral modules for the selected virtual VNA application command surface.
acceptance_criteria: Each application has command coverage reports and at least one end-to-end automation transcript.
notes: HOLD by product sequencing decision 2026-08-21: do not start this epic or any application child until scpi-303 (VNA) and scpi-704 (DMM/scalar) are complete and both are confirmed to use the same scpi-703 engine. Beads does not allow this epic to depend directly on task issues, so the hard dependency links are attached to every executable child.
close_reason: All five selected VNA application modules are implemented with option gates, shared scenario-backed workflows, command coverage reports, documentation, and end-to-end tests.

title: Retire emulator.py compatibility facade in a future major release
description: After a documented deprecation window, remove transitional imports from emulator.py and publish direct module import paths as a breaking release change.
acceptance_criteria: No internal code imports the facade; migration is documented; removal occurs only in a major release with all gates passing.

title: Remove remaining legacy dispatcher and dead server helpers
description: Clean up emulator.py after the typed-registry migration. Audit and remove the remaining pre-rewrite legacy IEEE-488.2/CSV command dispatcher once any still-required CSV behavior is isolated behind an explicit compatibility adapter, and remove the unused create_dashboard_template() function. The earlier fallback firmware inconsistency was resolved by the emulator identity migration: retained CSV fallback responses now use the shared E.1.0 firmware identity.
acceptance_criteria: Typed commands have one source of truth; any retained CSV fallback is narrowly isolated, named, and covered as a compatibility adapter rather than interleaved with the core server; create_dashboard_template() and other proven-unreachable helpers are removed; regression tests preserve supported CSV behavior.
close_reason: Removed the dead dashboard template generator and extracted the five-column CSV command path into an explicit CSVCommandAdapter. Moved *IDN?, *RST, *TST?, and SYST:VERS? into the typed registry, prevented CSV rows from overriding typed common behavior, and made manifest coverage typed-registry-only. Verified 320 passed, 1 skipped, 2 documented xfails with Ruff and diff checks clean.

title: Add dependency license inventory and distribution notices
description: Record direct and transitive dependency licenses, include the project MIT license in built artifacts, add third-party notices for MPL-2.0 bidict and MIT Socket.IO, remove or properly notice unused vendored assets, and add a repeatable license-policy check.
acceptance_criteria: Built wheels include the project license and third-party notices; runtime/dev dependency licenses and MPL source obligations are documented; CI detects disallowed or changed licenses.
close_reason: Added a reviewed 32-package direct/transitive all+dev license inventory, exact-version and metadata policy checker, CI enforcement, project and third-party notices in wheel/sdist artifacts, MPL/LGPL compliance notes, and release maintenance documentation. Removed the unused vendored Socket.IO JavaScript asset. Verified 322 passed, 1 skipped, 2 documented xfails; Ruff and license policy pass; wheel/sdist build warning-free with all compliance artifacts present.

comments.author: Danny I
comments.text: scpi-503 adds zeroconf>=0.150 as an optional discovery extra (and dev test dependency). PyPI declares LGPL-2.1-or-later; include zeroconf and transitive ifaddr in the dependency inventory/notice and license-policy check. The package is dynamically imported and not bundled.
